Package org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.model

Class ImmutableDnsEntry.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.model.ImmutableDnsEntry.Builder
Enclosing class:
ImmutableDnsEntry
@Generated(from="DnsEntry", generator="Immutables") public static final class ImmutableDnsEntry.Builder extends Object
Builds instances of type DnsEntry. Initialize attributes and then invoke the build() method to create an immutable instance.

Builder is not thread-safe and generally should not be stored in a field or collection, but instead used immediately to create instances.
